node.statement: The matrix-uniform extension is not a consequence of def-hcb-datum: that definition expressly packages data and notation only and supplies no estimates. Nor does compressed-product-display assert that all M_n tensor S_P are O(e)-C*-algebras. Thus an amplified-corner theorem (for example an allowed dependency asserting that S_P is an extended O(e)-C*-algebra) is logically necessary before parent 1.1 can be concluded.
